description: Stable identifier of the record in this release (R + the row number of the record in the frozen curation workbook).
Row number of the record in curation_workbook_parts1-4_FROZEN.xlsx (sheet records, header = row 1).
PMID of the paper the value comes from (must be a paper in sheet 'papers'). Rule: required; paper must have eligible = y and full_text_available = y, must not be skipped or retracted_flag = y.
DOI link of the paper, or its PubMed link when the paper has no DOI.

Where the printed value was read. Figures are not an allowed source (guideline §7, Q4). Rule: required when value_status = reported or pct_inhibition; leave blank when value_status = figure_only. Allowed values: table | text.
Table/figure/page label of the source, as printed (guideline §2: source_location = table/figure/page). Rule: required; for figure_only rows give the figure number.

reported = the potency number is printed in a table or the text. figure_only = it appears only in a figure (guideline §7, Q4). pct_inhibition = only a single-concentration % inhibition is given (Q8, Addendum A2-7): logged, excluded from every count. Rule: required. Allowed values: reported | figure_only | pct_inhibition.

Accepted plant species name as printed/standardised (Q2: Viridiplantae; green algae count and get 'algae' in notes). Rule: required for isolation = isolated_in_paper; write 'unspecified' for purchased standards (guideline §3).
Plant part the compound was isolated from. Rule: conditional on isolation = isolated_in_paper; otherwise leave blank.
Was the compound isolated in this paper, bought as a standard, or cited from earlier work (guideline §3)? Rule: required. Allowed values: isolated_in_paper | purchased | cited.
Compound name exactly as printed in the paper (guideline §3). Only purified, named or structurally characterised compounds. Rule: required.

test = compound under study; reference = positive control or reference drug (acyclovir, oseltamivir, remdesivir). Reference rows are excluded from all counts (guideline §3). Rule: required. Allowed values: test | reference.
y = semisynthetic derivative or synthetic analogue of a plant compound (Q3): recorded, never counted in headline numbers. Rule: required. Allowed values: y | n.
Virus name exactly as printed (guideline §6). Rule: required.
Strain / isolate / subtype text as printed (A/PR/8/34, H1N1, clade). Rule: leave blank if the paper gives none.
Drug-resistant mutant or named variant; each mutant is its own record (guideline §6). Rule: fill only for mutants; blank otherwise.

cell-based / replicon / pseudovirus / enzyme / in vivo (Q5). Cell-based and target-based results are reported separately. Rule: required. Allowed values: cell-based | replicon | pseudovirus | enzyme | in vivo.
Host cell line, or the enzyme/system used, as printed. Rule: required if given; if not given leave blank and say why in notes (guideline §8.5).
Protein/enzyme target as printed (UniProt is resolved later). Rule: conditional on assay_type = enzyme (or a named target); otherwise blank.

Antiviral potency endpoint. Only IC50, EC50, IC90, EC90, ED50 are entered (Addendum A1). Rule: required unless value_status = pct_inhibition (then blank). Allowed values: IC50 | EC50 | IC90 | EC90 | ED50.
Relation sign exactly as printed ('=', '<', '>', '~', 'about'). Rule: required if a sign is printed; blank if none.

Normalised relation: = < > <= >= or range (guideline §4; Addendum A2-6). '~', 'about' -> '=' plus flag approx; 'no activity up to 100 µM' -> '>' with value 100 plus flag inactive. Rule: required unless value_status = pct_inhibition (then blank). Allowed values: = | < | > | <= | >= | range.

The number exactly as printed (lower bound for a range). For pct_inhibition rows it is the tested concentration. Rule: required when value_status = reported or pct_inhibition; leave blank when figure_only.
Upper bound as printed for relation = range ('10-20 µM' -> 10 and 20), same unit as unit_raw. Rule: conditional on relation = range; otherwise blank.

Unit exactly as printed. Never convert by hand (Q7: original value and unit are always kept). Rule: required when value_raw is filled (for pct_inhibition rows: the concentration unit). Allowed values: nM | pM | µM | mM | µg/mL | ng/mL | mg/mL | mg/L | other.
Percent inhibition printed for a single tested concentration (Q8, Addendum A2-7). Such rows are logged but never counted. Rule: required when value_status = pct_inhibition (0-100); blank otherwise.
± SD/SEM and n as printed (guideline §2). Rule: blank if none printed.

y if the paper shows a dose-response (a concentration series, not one concentration) behind this value; n otherwise (Addendum A2-4; feeds the §9 confidence tier). Rule: required unless value_status = pct_inhibition. Allowed values: y | n.
Selectivity index exactly as the paper states it (guideline §5). Rule: blank if the paper gives none.

y if the paper reports a CC50-type value for this compound and assay, n if not (guideline §5). Must be y whenever cc50_value is filled. Rule: required unless value_status = pct_inhibition. Allowed values: y | n.

CC50 / TC50 / CD50 as printed, for this compound in the assay of this row (Addendum A2-1). Never a potency endpoint: it does not count toward numeric_potency or eligibility (A1). Rule: optional; only when value_status = reported and the paper prints the value; needs cc50_unit and cc50_same_cell_line.
Unit of cc50_value exactly as printed (same list as unit_raw). Rule: required when cc50_value is filled; otherwise blank. Allowed values: nM | pM | µM | mM | µg/mL | ng/mL | mg/mL | mg/L | other.

y = the CC50 was measured in the same cell line and assay as the antiviral value of this row; n = a different cell line (then si_computed stays empty; guideline §5). Rule: required when cc50_value is filled; otherwise blank. Allowed values: y | n.

Semicolon-separated tags, closed list (Addendum A2-3): algae (green-algal source, Q2), derivative_only (only derivatives/analogues were tested, Q3), surrogate_system (replicon, pseudotyped particles, VLPs or enzyme-only assay; Q5, §6). Rule: blank if none apply. Allowed values: algae; derivative_only; surrogate_system  (separate with ;).

Semicolon-separated flags: approx, inactive, type_assumed (HIV without type -> HIV-1), source_conflict (table vs text vs abstract disagree; winner kept, guideline §8.1), stereo_unspecified (name confirmed, Addendum A3-2). cc50_cell_mismatch is set automatically later. Rule: blank if none apply. Allowed values: approx; inactive; type_assumed; source_conflict; stereo_unspecified; cc50_cell_mismatch  (separate with ;).

Free text. Required whenever you leave an expected field empty (the reason; guideline §8.5). Write 'formulation' or 'combination' here when you skip such values (Addendum A2-2, A2-5). Rule: optional otherwise.

The curation method exactly as recorded in the workbook column `method`. The string is copied verbatim; it names how the record was produced and is NOT an independent check of the record. Accuracy of the records has not been measured (benchmark pending).
Where the value was read: full_text, abstract or unclear. Classified from `source_detail` (05_audit_master.py); 47 records are pending a ruling (origin_to_adjudicate.csv).

DERIVED. Potency value in nM: molar units scaled; mass units (ug/mL, mg/L, ng/mL, mg/mL) converted with the molecular weight of the resolved structure (decision Q7). Empty when no conversion was possible. value_raw and unit_raw are never changed.
DERIVED. y = converted from a mass concentration with a molecular weight; n = already molar; empty = not converted.
DERIVED. Why value_nM is filled or empty.
DERIVED. check_source when value_nM is above 1 mM or below 1 pM (guideline section 4); the value is still listed in values_to_check.csv for re-reading.
DERIVED. Full InChIKey of the structure matched to compound_name by name lookup (not checked by hand); empty when the name was not resolved.
DERIVED. Canonical SMILES of that structure.
DERIVED. PubChem CID when the structure came from PubChem.
DERIVED. How compound_name was matched to a structure: pass 1 PubChem name lookup, pass 2 (source and confidence), or not resolved (with the reason).
DERIVED. NCBI Taxonomy id of plant_species (species or genus level, see plant_resolution_status).
DERIVED. Family in the NCBI lineage of that taxon.
DERIVED. resolved / resolved_genus_only / unresolved / not_queried_*.
DERIVED. ICTV MSL41 species matched to virus_verbatim by string matching; empty when only genus or family could be matched.
DERIVED. ICTV family of the matched taxon.
DERIVED. ICTV genome type of the matched taxon.
DERIVED. plant / animal / human / bacteriophage / other from the project dictionary (heuristic; ICTV has no host field).
DERIVED. Rank reached by the virus match: species, genus or family.

DERIVED. Result of the compound x virus x value comparison with NPASS and ChEMBL: newly_curated, matches_npass, matches_chembl, matches_npass_and_chembl, unresolvable_compound, unresolvable_virus, value_untestable. newly_curated is a lower bound (unresolvable records may also be new).
DERIVED. NPASS compound ids (NPC...) of matches; ids only, no NPASS values.
DERIVED. PMIDs cited by those NPASS matches.
DERIVED. ChEMBL molecule ids of matches; ids only, no ChEMBL values.
DERIVED. ChEMBL document ids of matches.
DERIVED. y when the compound's structure is in the v1 database antiviral scope (compound-level only; v1 has no virus or value).
DERIVED. confirmed_duplicate_keeper / non_identical_same_key / empty (group of records with the same paper, compound, virus, cell line, endpoint, value and unit).
DERIVED. Columns in which the members of a non-identical duplicate group differ.
Project-lead ruling on an empty is_derivative cell (R001: unclear, pending adjudication). The recorded cell is empty.

For records whose plant_species is empty or 'unspecified': from assay paper / compound-level, external database / none found. Otherwise 'plant named in the record'. Compound-level provenance says where the compound occurs in general, not what the assay sample was.

Semicolon-separated flags added by the release; empty when none applies. possible_duplicate: the record belongs to a group of records with the same paper, compound, virus, cell line, endpoint, value and unit (20 groups in the workbook; nothing was deleted except 2 extra copies of one confirmed duplicate that are outside the release scope). in_vivo_with_ic50: assay_type is in vivo and the endpoint is IC50 or EC50. surrogate_untagged: assay_type is pseudovirus, replicon or enzyme and the tags column lacks surrogate_system. value_to_check: the record is listed in values_to_check.csv (value outside 1 pM to 1 mM, or a mass-unit value without a molecular weight). origin_unresolved: the evidence tier of the record is listed in origin_to_adjudicate.csv and has no ruling yet. unit_conflict_benchmark: the record is on one of three papers (part 2) where the benchmark experts read a unit 1,000 times away from the curated unit with the same number (7 sampled records checked, all 7 contradicted); the other records of those papers were not checked. A flag marks a possible problem; it does not say that the recorded value is wrong.
